name: @dataflow-visualizer/renderer-svg
description: SVG renderer for the dataflow visualizer

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=external -e @dataflow-visualizer/layout -e @dataflow-visualizer/protocol -e @dataflow-visualizer/runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
